system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the binary search algorithm specification. It extends the main binary search module and provides a finite-state override of the sequence operator, limiting sequences to a bounded maximum length so that the model checker can exhaustively explore the state space.
actors_and_components: Same as the binary search specification: a single sequential search procedure. This module adds no new actors but introduces a constant for the maximum sequence length.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the binary search specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the binary search specification, but with sequences restricted to those having length at most the configured maximum sequence length.
actions: Inherits all actions from the binary search specification without modification.
safety_properties: Inherits from the binary search specification. The model-checking configuration checks the correctness postcondition, the type invariant, and the full inductive invariant.
liveness_properties: The model-checking configuration checks the termination property (the algorithm eventually reaches its terminal state).
model_bounds: The value set is configured as a specific finite set of integers. The maximum sequence length is set to a specific integer. The sequence operator is overridden to produce only sequences up to the maximum length, making the state space finite.
additional_assumptions: The maximum sequence length must be a natural number. The overridden sequence operator generates all functions from index ranges 1 through k (for k from 1 to the maximum length) into the value set, rather than the infinite set of all possible-length sequences.
